title: rich priming present, but the message is iteration (new requirement) -> silent
rationale: Anti-regression guard for the priming layer: even when the plugin injects a full harness-surface inventory AND a write-log (so attribution and same-file signals are readily available), an additive new requirement is iteration, not a defect. Priming must NOT push the model to over-raise. Step 2 declines -> NO consent gate.
